# Open Innova

> Software and ongoing support for Italian Civil Service organisations, third-sector organisations and businesses.

Open Innova S.r.l. combines software development with knowledge of the third sector and organisational processes. Its purpose is to make technology useful and accessible in everyday work. The company was founded in 2026; the team's Civil Service software projects began in 2022.

## Products

- GestiSCU: management software for the Italian Universal Civil Service, from selection to volunteer management. Used by organisational staff, local project supervisors (OLP) and volunteers. Activities include selections, attendance, documents, training and tutoring.
- Custom management software: developed with organisations and businesses after studying workflows. Experience includes software for large football tournaments.

Clients purchase a licence to use the software. Open Innova retains the rights to the code and can reuse useful improvements across projects. Open innovation means collaboration and shared learning, not automatically open-source code or client ownership of source code. Client data and documents are not shared through this collaboration.

## Services and working process

The team listens to clients, observes workflows and visits their premises when useful. It develops a proposal with the client and then prepares a quote. Initial meetings and the work needed to prepare the quote are free of charge.

Software licensing may be accompanied by training, specific adaptations, assistance and operational support. For Civil Service organisations, support can include full management of agreed activities. Scope and terms are defined with each client.

Coaching and tutoring for volunteers can be commissioned by organisations separately from the software. Training also includes practical educational projects: an eight-day bootcamp took place in June 2026 with four vocational school students as part of a project aimed at preventing early school leaving.

Clients maintain direct contact with the development team. Maintenance and improvements to security, performance and resource efficiency continue over time.

## People

- Giovanni Rende: co-founder and sole director; third-sector, Civil Service and organisational experience.
- Daniele Nucciarelli: co-founder; software architecture and cloud infrastructure.
- Emanuele Persichini: co-founder and full-stack developer.

## Contact

Write to info@openinnova.it, even without a solution or specification in mind.
GestiSCU: gestiscu@openinnova.it. Process consulting: business@openinnova.it. Custom software: dev@openinnova.it.

## Website

Static Hugo website hosted on AWS S3 in Milan and distributed through CloudFront. No cookies, analytics, profiling tools or externally loaded fonts and libraries. Contact forms prepare a message in the visitor's email app; visitors send it from there. Technical infrastructure data and email enquiries are described in the privacy notice.

Website code is public under the repository's stated licences. Brand assets, copy and company data remain protected. Environmental estimates are model-based, not measurements of individual visits.
